ZHIJIANG_KEYWORD_YANG.title: Yang
ZHIJIANG_KEYWORD_YANG.description: [gold]Yang[/gold] card. Bella is in the [gold]Bai La[/gold] state when [gold]Yang[/gold] cards outnumber [gold]Yin[/gold] cards. The [gold]Yin-Yang[/gold] difference is the gap between the number of [gold]Yang[/gold] and [gold]Yin[/gold] cards. A card whose [gold]Yin-Yang[/gold] opposes your current [gold]Bai La / Hei La[/gold] state is called a [gold]Contrast card[/gold].
